cases.name: dict-subclasses
cases.source:
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def f(*,x=1): return x
d=defaultdict(lambda:99,x=7)
f.__kwdefaults__=d
print(f(),f.__kwdefaults__ is d)
c=Counter(x=8)
f.__kwdefaults__=c
print(f(),f.__kwdefaults__ is c)
del c['x']
try: f()
except TypeError: print('missing')

cases.name: tuple-subclass
cases.source:
from collections import namedtuple
Defaults=namedtuple('Defaults','value')
def f(x): return x
d=Defaults(7)
f.__defaults__=d
print(f(),f.__defaults__ is d)
